literal: By the relationship of closeness internal enmity if appears, in the manner of destruction harms many it will give.
translation: If internal enmity arises among those bound by close ties, it will bring many harms that lead to utter destruction.
modern: நெருங்கிய உறவுடையவர்களிடம் உட்பகை தோன்றினால், அது அழிவைத் தரும் வகையில் பல துன்பங்களையும் கொடுக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet warns of the devastating consequences of conflict within a close-knit group. The word 'முறை' (muṟai) is used twice with slightly different nuances: first as 'relationship' or 'kinship' in 'உறல்முறையான்' (those connected by close ties), and second as 'manner' or 'way' in 'இறல்முறையான்' (in a manner leading to ruin). If 'உட்பகை' (internal enmity) takes root among close associates, it does not merely cause temporary trouble. Instead, it brings 'ஏதம் பலவும்' (many harms) that inevitably lead to 'இறல்' (destruction).
